continuity.box: matte charcoal-black rigid premium phone box with subtle Wiffeyyyy OS lid mark
continuity.phone: modern premium black smartphone, portrait aspect, thin black bezel, centered dynamic-island-style top cutout, no external brand logo
continuity.hands: two realistic fitted matte black presentation gloves, natural human proportions, no jewelry, no sleeves entering beyond wrists
continuity.lighting: soft warm key from high front-left, very faint cool-neutral rim from rear-right, deep controlled shadows
continuity.camera: cinematic product camera, smooth stabilized dolly/tilt only, no handheld shake, no speed ramps
continuity.lens: normal-to-short-telephoto product-film perspective, avoid wide-angle distortion

shots.framing: low three-quarter side view, box centered slightly below frame center
shots.action: hold on closed box; extremely subtle slow push-in; premium lighting reveals lid edges and material
shots.mustEndWith: box stable and centered; hands still outside frame

shots.framing: same composition and lens as establishing shot
shots.action: two black-gloved hands enter naturally from lower left and lower right; fingertips contact opposite sides of the box and steady it
shots.camera: continue tiny push-in; no cut in apparent camera position
shots.mustEndWith: both hands making believable contact with box; box has not shifted unnaturally

shots.framing: camera eases upward toward near top-down while keeping box centered
shots.action: one hand stabilizes box base while the other lifts lid slowly; tray and black-screen phone are revealed
shots.camera: smooth crane/tilt transition toward top-down; no sudden orbital move
shots.mustEndWith: lid clear of phone; phone still seated flat in tray; hands remain anatomically believable

shots.framing: camera begins easing from top-down toward frontal product view
shots.action: gloved fingers grip phone by edges only and lift it smoothly from tray; phone rotates from tray angle toward upright portrait orientation
shots.camera: gentle synchronized dolly/tilt to keep phone centered and growing continuously in apparent size
shots.screenState: screen fully black with subtle glass reflections only
shots.mustEndWith: phone upright enough to face camera; box/lid beginning to fall into dark background; no fingers covering screen

shots.action: phone continues a small controlled move toward camera and settles; hands release and exit below/side frame; display wakes with a restrained purple-neutral glow
shots.camera: finish dolly and settle completely before handoff
shots.screenState: starts black, then soft simplified purple glow; avoid AI-generated text/icons
shots.mustEndWith: phone dead-center, perfectly upright, no hands touching it, camera stable, clean dark negative space around device

shots.framing: locked hero frame matching live phone geometry
shots.action: hold stable composition while website live-phone bridge takes over; authored footage should not introduce new motion
shots.screenState: cinematic screen may remain a dark/purple simplified state; exact live UI is supplied by website bridge
shots.mustEndWith: no camera motion, no hand, no box crossing phone, no focus or exposure change

negativeConstraints: no lid passing through hand or box
no motion blur covering final frame
no lens flare across phone screen
